development_interpretation: Under the matched seed-0 TRM-4 setting, parameter-free RecencyWeightedHistory improved final development accuracy by approximately 1.37 percentage points over vanilla TRM and reduced language-model loss. The development accuracy advantage was present throughout the recorded training trajectory and was not limited to the final checkpoint.
scientific_note: Because the method adds zero trainable parameters, the observed seed-0 improvement cannot be attributed simply to increased trainable model capacity.
statistical_caveat: This is a single-seed development result. It does not establish statistical superiority. Multi-seed paired evaluation is required before final claims.
